user.title: Sensables.IO IAQ Setup
user.description:
Configure your Sensables.IO IAQ webhook integration.

Your webhook URL will be: {webhook_url}

data_description.webhook_id: Unique identifier for your webhook endpoint (alphanumeric and underscores only)
data_description.sensor_prefix: Prefix for all sensor entities (e.g., 'sensables' creates sensor.sensables_device_temperature)
data_description.location: Optional location name to include in sensor names (e.g., 'Kitchen' creates Kitchen Temperature)
data_description.temperature_unit: Choose whether to display temperature in Celsius or Fahrenheit (data will be converted automatically)
data_description.expire_after: Time in seconds after which inactive sensors are automatically removed (60-604800)

error.invalid_webhook_id: Webhook ID must contain only letters, numbers, and underscores
error.invalid_sensor_prefix: Sensor prefix must contain only letters, numbers, and underscores
error.invalid_expire_after: Expire time must be between 60 seconds and 7 days (604800 seconds)

abort.already_configured: Integration with this webhook ID is already configured

init.title: Sensables.IO IAQ Options
init.description:
Update your Sensables.IO IAQ configuration.

Current webhook URL: {current_webhook_url}

data_description.webhook_id: Unique identifier for your webhook endpoint (changing this will create a new endpoint)
data_description.sensor_prefix: Prefix for all sensor entities (changing this may create duplicate sensors)
data_description.location: Optional location name to include in sensor names
data_description.temperature_unit: Temperature display unit (automatic conversion from Celsius if needed)
data_description.expire_after: Time in seconds after which inactive sensors are automatically removed

error.webhook_id: Webhook ID must contain only letters, numbers, and underscores
error.invalid_sensor_prefix: Sensor prefix must contain only letters, numbers, and underscores
error.invalid_expire_after: Expire time must be between 60 seconds and 7 days (604800 seconds)
